Amends the seed rule again; this is the final form. Jack Heart (2026-11-12): "so literally like expanding evvery possible pairing, then recollapsing", then "and maybe having a mode that just picks a random seed for all games for each side for speed?". Default: every pairing, the full A x B of the two jobs' launched seeds, games split evenly over the |A|*|B| pairs (remainder to the lowest pairs in ascending-seed order) and pooled into the point. No lcm or modulo. A speed mode on the Seating, e.g. `seeds: Literal["every", "one"] = "every"`: "one" plays all of a point's games between one seed of each side, chosen pseudo-randomly from the seating's name and the seed sets (never the clock), so it is the same pair at every point and on every hold (a smooth curve, idempotent); a change to either seed set may choose again. Docs: one line on the trade (speed, but the curve shows one seed pair, not the job).
